name: @red-cup-engineering/a2a-agent-card-discovery-service

scripts.check: node --check src/discover-agent-card.mjs && node --check src/carriers.mjs && node --check test/discover-agent-card.test.mjs

description: Discovers the exact standard Agent Card resource and optionally verifies its single same-origin JWS/JWKS boundary. `./carriers` exposes Draft 2020-12 JSON request, result, and refusal carriers and a derived schema-to-EAVT projection. Private signing keys are neither consumed nor packed.
